title: Pulse-resolved post-generation phase control of squeezed light at 93 MHz with a bulk lithium-niobate modulator
summary: Time-domain multiplexing of continuous-variable quantum states provides a scalable approach to photonic quantum information processing, in which individual temporal modes can be sequentially manipulated within a common optical path. Here we demonstrate pulse-resolved post-generation phase control of squeezed-vacuum states at a repetition rate of 93 MHz using a low-loss bulk lithium-niobate electro-optic modulator driven by a broadband RF power amplifier.
